company.name: Automax AI
company.shortDescription: Automax AI builds AI assistants for real-estate appraisers, with an Appraisal Copilot for data prep, comps, and report drafting.
company.description: Automax AI provides AI-powered tools that streamline property appraisal workflows. The Appraisal Copilot assists real‑estate appraisers by ingesting documents and photos, organizing property files, extracting key details, suggesting comparable properties, and drafting report sections and narratives. Solutions address residential, commercial, and agricultural assignments, and include options for custom assistants aligned to firm templates and processes. Capabilities include document ingestion, structured data extraction, worksheet population, workfile assembly, and quality checks. An assistant interface supports follow‑up questions, edits, and iteration on drafts, enabling practitioners to focus on analysis and final review.
